title: Credit Risk Model Developer
full_description:
At ING we are looking for a Credit Risk Model Developer
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for a talented and enthusiasticCredit Risk Model Developerto join ourRetail Credit RiskTeamwithinING Risk Domain.
The responsibility of the Retail Credit Risk team is to oversight the risk in the Spanish Retail Lending portfolio during the whole credit lifecycle, and our way of working is 100% flexible, in small subject-expert areas, and with a continuous interaction with international teams.
Your key responsibilities:
As a Credit Risk Model Developer expert you will:
Develop EAD, PD, LGD IRB and IFRS9 models for ING Spain retail portfolios of Mortgages and Consumer Lending, ensuring that all modelling activities align with regulatory expectations, internal governance standards, and business objectives.
You will be involved in the credit risk models life cycle: data sourcing, model development, model documentation and support model validation, audit reviews (internal and external) and model implementation.
You will play a critical role in the development of models, driving innovation in modelling practices.
ING Spain is developing locally this new capability, responsible for regulatory model development end-to-end, you will have the chance to build the success of the team, with the support of other colleagues, ING Group in Amsterdam and the Risk Hub center of expertise in Poland. ING is going through a growth phase in Spain, and models play a key role to support the growth. You will be one of the key factors in making that happen.
What are we looking for?
Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Economics, Statistics, Maths or similar quantitative field.
+2-5 years of quantitative Risk models development experience.
Excellent knowledge of statistics and/or mathematics, as well as programming in SAS and SQL. Knowledge of databases, data preparation, data modelling and data quality controls.
Have extensive knowledge of IRB and IFRS 9 models. Good understanding and interpretation of regulatory credit risk policies, attention to detail and accuracy.
Have an ability to identify problems, analyze key information and make connections, in order to find pragmatic and feasible solutions.
We will also value knowledge and experience in a) machine learning techniques, b) programming in Python, c) in other types of risk models (e.g. credit decision models for acceptance, prepayment models) and d) experience in being a sparring partner/advisor to Senior Management.
Fluent English and Spanish language skills.
Availability for occasional travels to attend training or meetings in other ING locations.
The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.
Check out what is waiting for you!
Be flexible my friend.
Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues’ needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.
So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.
Our house will be your home.
In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!
For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).
We help you protect what matters most to you.
Flexible remuneration.
In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…
Free company shuttle.
It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.
Special loans with more beneficial conditions.
Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.
And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!
More vitality and more belonging
360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).
Physiotherapy service on site.
Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.
Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.
International Remote work program.
Queremos incorporar a una persona con talento y entusiasmo para desempeñarse comoCredit Risk Model Developeren nuestro equipo deRetail Credit Risk, dentro del dominio de Riesgos de ING.
La responsabilidad del equipo de Retail Credit Risk es supervisar el riesgo en la cartera de préstamos minoristas en España durante todo el ciclo de vida del crédito. Nuestro modelo de trabajo es 100% flexible, en áreas pequeñas de especialización y con interacción continua con equipos internacionales.
Como especialista enCredit Risk Model Developer, te encargarás de:
Desarrollar modelos EAD, PD, LGD IRB e IFRS9 para las carteras minoristas de ING España (hipotecas y préstamos al consumo), asegurando que todas las actividades de modelización cumplan con las expectativas regulatorias, los estándares internos de gobernanza y los objetivos del negocio.
Participar en todo el ciclo de vida de los modelos de riesgo de crédito: obtención de datos, desarrollo del modelo, documentación y apoyo en la validación, revisiones de auditoría (internas y externas) e implementación del modelo.
Jugar un papel clave en el desarrollo de modelos, impulsando la innovación en las prácticas de modelización.
ING España está desarrollando localmente esta nueva capacidad, responsable del desarrollo de modelos regulatorios de principio a fin. Tendrás la oportunidad de contribuir al éxito del equipo, con el apoyo de otras personas, del grupo ING en Ámsterdam y del centro de experiencia Risk Hub en Polonia. ING está en una fase de crecimiento en España, y los modelos son fundamentales para apoyar este crecimiento. Tú serás una de las piezas clave para hacerlo posible.
¿Quieres saber si este puesto es para ti? Estas son algunas de las cualidades que más valoramos. Si encajas… ¡no dudes en postularte!
